metadata.title: On global Chern-Calabi flows on compact complex surfaces
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we propose the Chern-Calabi Flow for extremal metrics in conformal Hermitian geometry. After the existence of extremal metric, we consider the existence of global flows to the Chern-Calabi flows for extremal metrics on compact complex surfaces with Gauduchon metrics. To achieve this goal, we use the Adams inequality and the Gronwall inequality method to obtain fourth order derivative norm estimates. We also study the convergence of the global solution to the Chern-Calabi flow and its limit is the solution of the Chern-Calabi extremal metric problem. We propose a fourth order elliptic problem and derive the Bochner formula relevant to the elliptic estimates for the Chern-Calabi heat flow.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 几何流框架与延拓收敛
analysis.workSummary: 提出共形 Hermitian 几何中的 Chern–Calabi 流，研究紧复曲面 Gauduchon 度量背景下的长期行为。
techniques: 四阶导数控制与 Bochner 公式
analysis.breakthrough: 通过四阶估计研究全局解及其向 Chern–Calabi 极值度量的收敛，并提出相应四阶椭圆问题。
analysis.limitations: 摘要提及极值度量存在后的流问题，不能据此宣称所有 Hermitian 共形类无条件存在全局收敛流；需核对正文的先验和存在性条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 与同日高维延拓论文互补，但全局陈述需要严格区分假设。
